changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0074. One-to-one tenant chat: permission rules, conversations, participants, messages, and attachment metadata. Binaries stay in the existing file store. Index review: PK on each table; FK indexes on TenantId, ConversationId, UserId, MessageId, and StoredFileId; UX_ChatConversations_TenantId_PairKey prevents a second direct thread for the same pair; UX_ChatParticipants_ConversationId_UserId and IX_ChatParticipants_TenantId_UserId serve membership and inbox; IX_ChatMessages_Conversation_Cursor pages history without a full scan; UX_ChatMessages_Idempotency stops duplicate submits; UX_ChatPermissionRules_TenantId_RuleCode keeps one rule per pair. Performance note: every list index leads with TenantId or ConversationId.

changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0075. Enable GYM_CHAT on business plans and grant chat permissions. Index review: catalog inserts use existing unique keys. Performance note: a fixed catalog write.
